Use case: illustration-story. Generate a NEW Chapter 6 story atlas, not edits to the reference scenes. EXACT 2x2 edge-to-edge grid of four equal landscape 3:2 paintings; overall 1536x1024, no gutters, borders, captions or text. References are CHARACTER AND STYLE references only. Match their luminous rich painterly storybook realism, fine furry faces, textured cloth, autumn foliage, warm amber lighting and blue night shadows. Keep subjects within their own panel. Poppy is the SMALL cream rabbit in plum cape, rust scarf, brown satchel, exactly TWO ears, one upright and one gently bent; Willow is the taller youthful grey-brown rabbit, moss-green coat, exactly TWO upright ears, no bag. Bram is broad black-and-white badger in dark green coat. Ferryman is brown otter in slate-blue raincoat and brown knit cap. Baker is brown hedgehog in cream apron over burgundy sleeves. Mender is adult fox woman in ochre dress/coat and grey shawl with wrapped ankle. Apprentice is tan rabbit in blue coat holding a brown work case. Extra neighbour when specified is brown vole in teal raincoat, NO hat. Poppy's lamp is brass with glass chimney; Willow's is rectangular amber PAPER lantern. Show ONLY characters specified for each panel, no duplicates. No embedded frogs, UI, lettering or watermarks. Give top-left panel an unobstructed natural shelf or leafy stone ledge at left middle height for later game overlay; do NOT draw a frog. No extra ears or limbs. Four different chronological paintings, in reading order:
TOP LEFT: Late rainy night, careful stretcher return on broad wooded path with roots. Otter and teal vole carry canvas stretcher holding fox mender, blue apprentice walks beside holding case. Bram follows with coiled rope and small bronze bell, Willow with paper lantern. Poppy and baker NOT here. TOP RIGHT: At signal rock, Poppy rises to greet seated weary Bram, grey scarf slipping to stone beside her; baker nearby, rescued party in background. BOTTOM LEFT: Intimate view Poppy and Bram at rock, he sets down small bronze bell with a clearly chipped lip; his green sleeve has torn cuff with crooked yellow stitching. Willow observes quietly. No flashback. BOTTOM RIGHT: Poppy and Willow walk towards warm bakery windows along village lane, Willow quietly speaks, Poppy listens thoughtfully, other rescuers ahead. Night still dark.
